children.content: Builds one block with its own ID from a
file. The module decides what kind of block it is:
(the default) for a plain cube,  mmdlib:stairs ,
and the other block parts, a module another mod registers, or a
. Values start from the module's template; the block is also put in  minecraft:mineable/pickaxe .

content.content: . MMDLib generates its blockstate, models, name, loot table and tags; its textures must come from  scripts/mmdlibdata . The log lists the textures each block needs.
For complete ZenCode examples with imports, loader selection and surrounding configuration, open Examples / Cookbook in the wiki navigation.
